provenance.crypto: Synthetic RustCrypto deterministic test keys/signatures; independently signed artifacts record their own tool provenance. No native crypto in the engine.
provenance.warning: Test-only PE/CFB containers. Never execute these artifacts. Synthetic signing keys are public test constants; external fixtures have individual provenance.
provenance.interop_status: Synthetic PE/MSI corpus plus independently jsign 7.6-signed MSI and an unmodified upstream signtool fixture. Specific checks only; not full interoperability or Windows policy equivalence.

artifacts.description: Correctly signed CA certificate with KeyUsage missing keyCertSign.
Nonzero byte inside WIN_CERTIFICATE after the complete CMS DER object; reject as certificate-table payload error.
One signature byte changed without changing the signed PE image.
Timestamp after the pinned validation time.

Paired with good-pe64.exe: only the signed section byte at file offset 700 is XORed with 1; the embedded CMS signature is unchanged and remains valid for the original image. Computed PE SHA-256 (hash a): 821ba3d28e9ea20b53901de76a090d109e9dced8426ca75f2f844543b59cd243. Signed PE SHA-256 (hash b): dea5b51087a941e1757bc435b116fc1a7dfc9c8343bf4cb27b7fc9431a9dd30f. Expected error: image_digest_mismatch at image_digest stage.
Valid CMS signature over deliberately incorrect page hashes.
Timestamp token signed by a code-signing certificate instead of a TSA certificate.
Signed RFC 3161 token with a mismatched parent-signature imprint.
Byte appended after the certificate table; rejected layout.
Signed PE truncated inside its optional header.
Authentic root-issued CRL whose nextUpdate is before the pinned validation time.
Current CRL with a modified signature byte.
PKCS#9 countersignature binding a signed signingTime to the publisher signature.
Valid chain through a CA without an EKU extension; CA is unrestricted by EKU.
PE checksum changed; excluded from the Authenticode image digest.
Two valid Authenticode signatures, one nested in an unsigned attribute.
Valid SHA-256 image and page hashes.
Valid synthetic PE32 with a SHA-256/ECDSA P-256 Authenticode signature.
Valid synthetic PE32+ with a SHA-256/ECDSA P-256 Authenticode signature.
RFC 3161 timestamp with valid binding to the publisher signature and dedicated TSA EKU.
Authentic current root-issued CRL with no revoked serials.
Plain text, not a PE image.
Authentic current root-issued CRL listing the test publisher serial.
Test root certificate. Trusted explicitly by corpus cases, never installed in the OS store.
Unrelated test root with a different subject and key.
Synthetic PE32+ with no embedded signature.
SignerInfo declares unknown digest OID 2.16.840.1.101.3.4.2.127; report unsupported algorithm.
SignerInfo declares unknown ECDSA signature OID 1.2.840.10045.4.3.127; reject before claiming mathematical invalidity.
Correctly signed attributes contain the digest of different CMS content; PE image digest remains correct.
Correctly signed contentType attribute declares TSTInfo while encapsulated content is SpcIndirectDataContent.
SignerInfo names an unrelated issuer; serial and signed attributes remain unchanged.
SignerInfo names serial 99 instead of the embedded signer certificate serial 2; issuer is unchanged.
SignedData digestAlgorithms declares SHA384 while SignerInfo and the content digest use SHA256.
Signature algorithm declares ECDSA-with-SHA384 while SignerInfo digestAlgorithm is SHA256.
Signature algorithm declares RSA while the embedded signer certificate contains an EC public key.
Root-signed signer certificate contains a different valid P256 public key; CMS is signed by the original key.
Correctly signed PKCS9 countersignature attributes bind to different parent signature bytes.
Only the RFC3161 token signer signature is corrupted; parent CMS signature and timestamp imprint remain valid.
Only the PKCS9 countersignature signature is corrupted; parent CMS signature and countersignature content digest remain valid.
Only the nested CMS signature is corrupted; outer CMS signature and both PE image digests remain valid.
Root-signed leaf certificate notBefore is NOW+1; CMS signature and image digest are valid.
Root-signed leaf certificate notAfter is NOW-1; CMS signature and image digest are valid.
Root-signed leaf has serverAuth instead of codeSigning EKU; CMS signature remains valid.
Root-signed leaf permits keyEncipherment but lacks digitalSignature; CMS signature remains valid.
Only the leaf certificate ECDSA signature is corrupted; the PE image and CMS signature are valid.
Only the intermediate certificate ECDSA signature is corrupted; leaf certificate signature and CMS signature remain valid.
Correctly root-signed CRL has thisUpdate NOW+1 while nextUpdate remains NOW+1000. Expected crl_not_yet_valid.
Current CRL signed by the deterministic intermediate CA key, covering the leaf of good-intermediate.exe. Paired with good.crl for complete chain revocation coverage.
